title: El muchacho que me escribió de ustedes: el gerente que se dio cuenta (Serie Sala de Juntas, video 15)

ia.dice: Hoy yo mismo voy a llamar a los leads que mis asesores inmobiliarios dieron por perdidos.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Daytime, the sales manager's office of a real estate agency with a glass wall. Fabián, the sales director of a real estate agency, a Mexican man in his forties with a neatly trimmed beard, square black glasses and a fitted navy blazer over a black turtleneck, sits at his desk with a printed list of leads, dials on his phone and puts it to his ear, determined and says in Mexican Spanish, determined, firm: "Hoy yo mismo voy a llamar a los leads que mis asesores inmobiliarios dieron por perdidos." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, office ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: No, ya compré, gracias. El muchacho que me escribió de ustedes me consiguió otro departamento.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Daytime, a bright cozy living room. Señora Lupita, a cheerful Mexican woman in her fifties with a short curly brown bob, big sunglasses on her head and a colorful blouse, sits on her sofa talking on the phone, happy and friendly and says in Mexican Spanish, cheerful and chatty: "No, ya compré, gracias. El muchacho que me escribió de ustedes me consiguió otro departamento." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only her voice in Spanish, quiet home ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Daytime, the sales manager's office of a real estate agency with a glass wall. Fabián, the sales director of a real estate agency, a Mexican man in his forties with a neatly trimmed beard, square black glasses and a fitted navy blazer over a black turtleneck, holds the phone, confused, then realizes, his face turns red with fury, he stands up and looks through the glass wall toward the agents' desks and says in Mexican Spanish, confused, then furious shouting: "¿Otro departamento? ¿Con quién…? ¡Rodrigo!" Close-up, slow push-in. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, office ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

scenes.text: Ese gerente se enteró de suerte. Si cada asesor atiende los leads en su WhatsApp personal, casi nunca te vas a enterar.
Lead Master se conecta al WhatsApp y a las llamadas de tus asesores y vendedores, y en automático te dice qué pasó con cada lead. Todos los días te llega el reporte, sin que nadie llene nada.

scenes.text: Las llamadas salen del sistema y quedan grabadas. Y si el asesor se va, los leads y todo su historial se quedan en tu inmobiliaria.
Si tienes una inmobiliaria con asesores, comenta LEADS y te lo instalamos.
